primary_focus: Third-party inventory parity + on-demand refresh. Agent now enumerates per-user Uninstall hives (HKU\<SID> native + WOW6432Node) in addition to HKLM, matching what appwiz.cpl and Settings > Apps show — per-user installs like Chrome / Teams / Zoom are now visible to the server catalog. Agent also handles a new signed command 'report_device_state' that resets the Layer-1 fingerprint and triggers an immediate DeviceStateReport, so the console / NSH can pull a fresh inventory snapshot on demand (not only after an install/uninstall change). Mockserver NSH gains 'inventory refresh [--timeout N]' with parallel dispatch, shared deadline, and a 100-target cap (NSH is a dev / admin tool; fleet-wide refresh belongs in a server-side scheduled operation).
